faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: Q: Must I fill in all keys to use the system?
faq.a1: No. Only the AI Analysis Key is required. Other data sources can be enabled as needed. Unconfigured sources are automatically skipped.
faq.q2: Q: Do I need to restart after adding a key?
faq.a2: No. Changes take effect immediately after saving. The next collection cycle will use the new key.
faq.a3: All API keys are encrypted in the database. The frontend only shows masked values (e.g. sk-****abc), never plain text.
faq.q4: Q: Are free data sources sufficient?
faq.a4: Free sources (Binance + Alternative.me + BlockBeats + CryptoPanic + CoinGecko Demo) cover K-line, futures, fear index, news, and fundamentals. Paid sources (CoinGlass, GlassNode, CoinGecko Pro) add derivatives, on-chain depth, and community sentiment.
